---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a change or addition to TIER
title: "feat: "
labels: enhancement
---

**The problem**
What are you trying to do that TIER doesn't support today?

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like TIER to do.

**Alternatives considered**
Other approaches you thought about, and why they fall short.

**Scope check**
<!-- TIER is deliberately a single-tenant, deterministic measurement tool. If the
request touches multi-tenancy, an event bus, or a second datastore, note why —
those are intentionally out of scope until a real driving requirement exists. -->

**Additional context**
Anything else — links, prior art, screenshots.
